title: POSI Annual Category Ranking
description: One record per (journal_id, category_code, metric_year). A journal with 1 primary + up to 2 secondary PSC categories gets up to 3 ranking records per year.

category_code.description: PSC code this ranking is computed within.

rank.description: Conventional competition ranking shown to users (1, 2, 2, 4, 5, ...) — tied journals share the same integer rank.

rank_mid.description: Mid-rank used only for the percentile formula (e.g. two journals tied for 5th/6th place both get rank=5, rank_mid=5.5). Not shown to users directly.

category_size.description: Count of metric_eligible journals in this category this year — the ranking denominator.

quartile.description: Q1 >= 75th percentile, Q2 >= 50th, Q3 >= 25th, Q4 otherwise. Null when ranking_method is 'unavailable'.

ranking_method.description: 'unavailable' when category_size is below MIN_CATEGORY_SIZE (see PJR-SPEC.md) — quartiles are not assigned for undersized categories, full stop.

tied_with.description: Other journal_ids sharing this exact rank via mid-rank tie handling.
